title: 第7章 血洗北域的那一位第8章 认怂的青羊老祖秦王虐子
slug: 八年质子归京岂知天下已刻吾名
lines: 对于影的实力，他放心。
自从剑老离开后，影便暗中跟随着自己。
而她，也是天机阁中最强的几人之一。
甚至，在暗杀这方面，连剑老都不敢招架，名副其实的影子杀手。
“是！殿下！”
影点头之间，手中黑色长刀抬起，径直朝那袭来的中年男子杀去。
这中年男子还未袭至，只感觉眼前一黑，瞬间被血色所取代。
他手中的长剑断开，连带着双手被横斩，掉落成四节，胸前一道血线浮现，后背只差三寸便要彻底断开。
这烟雨楼的大宗师，至死都不敢想象，他竟然会在一个瘦弱的女人手下一招毙命。
而且，这还是他以剑横挡的情况之下。
要知道，他手中这把寒灵剑，乃千年寒铁所铸，饮过域外魔血，已经通灵。
非面对能威胁自身的强者，他从不祭出。
可结果，还是断了。
“你手中是什么刀！”
“来我烟雨楼杀人，未免太过霸……”
“轰隆隆！”
随着中年男子毙命，烟雨楼中一些老家伙坐不住了，走出的瞬间，眸光死死的盯着影手中的黑色长刀露出贪念，欲联手击杀抢夺。
对于寒灵剑，他们十分了解，这可是放眼整个京城都难寻的神兵。
除了镇守皇宫的皇天剑，承天剑，以及那些名动天下神兵利器，如山河剑，破风剑，青鸾剑，紫霄剑等，还没有什么兵器能一击将其斩断！
这黑色长刀，他们从未见过，更未听闻，显然不是那些神兵！
甚至，有可能不属于大虞皇朝。
“杀人刀！”
影不等这开口老者把话说完，一刀直接砍掉其头颅，冷冷吐出三个字。
她只听孟尘的话，烟雨楼内出手者，全部杀干净！
所以，这些人都要死。
“找死！”
其余三个老者见状，纷纷心脏狂跳，直接联手。
这黑衣女子出手太快，干脆利落，远超乎他们的想象，若不联手围杀，后果难以预料。
话音刚落，黑色刀光已然掠过，三人冲在最前的一个，眉心直接被劈开，身体坠入湖中。
剩下两人脊骨生寒，彻底麻了。
他们堂堂大宗师，背靠烟雨楼，从来只有他们欺负别人，享受众人的目光仰视，什么时候被人这般杀过。
其中一个大喝之下，猛地转身就逃。
下方他们栖居的那座岛屿之中，有强者驾临，若对方愿意出手，可保性命！
就在这大喝老者转身逃走的刹那，一声惨叫传来，冲上去的那人直接被一刀斩杀。
临死，他这才反应过来。
他想要怒骂那逃跑的老者一声你妈的大傻逼！
结果，没机会喊出口了。
“逃，也是死！”
影看了一眼逃走的老者，手中长刀祭出，化作一道死亡黑光，直接从背后将其洞穿。
五指隔空一抓，那离手的黑色长刀，犹如被控制一般，又回到了她的手中。
content_en:
He was assured of Ying's strength.
Ever since Jian Lao left, Ying has followed him secretly.
And she is also one of the strongest people in Tianji Pavilion.
Even in terms of assassination, even Jian Lao didn't dare to parry, and he was a veritable shadow killer.
"Yes! Your Highness!"
As Ying nodded, he raised the long black knife in his hand and went straight towards the middle-aged man who was attacking.
"Chi!"
Before the middle-aged man could attack him, he felt his eyes go dark and was instantly replaced by blood.
The long sword in his hand was broken, and his hands were slashed horizontally, falling into four sections. A line of blood appeared on his chest, and his back was only three inches away from being completely severed.
The great master of Yanyu Tower never dared to imagine that he would be killed by a thin woman with one move.
Moreover, this was when he blocked it with his sword.
You must know that the Cold Spirit Sword in his hand is made of thousands of years of cold iron. He has drank the blood of demons from outside the realm and has become psychic.
He never takes action unless faced with a strong person who can threaten him.
But in the end, it was still broken.
"What kind of knife is that in your hand?"
"Coming to my Yanyu Tower to kill people would be too overbearing..."
"Boom!"
As the middle-aged man died, some old guys in the Yanyu Building couldn't sit still. The moment they walked out, their eyes were fixed on the black long knife in Ying's hand, showing greed, wanting to join forces to kill and rob him.
They knew the Cold Spirit Sword very well. This was a magic weapon that was difficult to find in the entire capital.
Except for the Emperor's Heaven Sword, the Bearing Heaven Sword that guards the palace, and those famous magical weapons in the world, such as the Mountain River Sword, the Breaking Wind Sword, the Qingluan Sword, the Zixiao Sword, etc., there is no weapon that can cut it off with one blow!
They had never seen this long black sword, let alone heard of it. It was obviously not one of those magic weapons!
It is even possible that he did not belong to the Dayu Dynasty.
"Murderous Knife!"
Ying didn't wait for the old man to finish his words, cut off his head with a knife, and spat out three words coldly.
She only listened to Meng Chen's words, and killed all those who took action in Yanyu Tower!
So, these people are going to die.
"Seeking death!"
When the other three old men saw this, their hearts beat wildly and they joined forces directly.
The woman in black struck too quickly and neatly, far beyond their imagination. If they didn't join forces to kill her, the consequences would be unpredictable.
"Chi!"
As soon as he finished speaking, the black sword light had already passed by. The one of the three who rushed forward had his eyebrows split open and his body fell into the lake.
"Up!"
The remaining two people felt chills running down their spines and were completely numb.
They were great masters, with their backs to the Misty Rain Tower. They had always been the only ones to bully others and enjoy the attention of everyone. When had they ever been killed like this?
One of them shouted loudly, turned around and ran away.
On the island where they live below, a strong man is coming. If the other party is willing to take action, his life can be saved!
"You!"
At the moment when the shouting old man turned around and ran away, a scream came out, and the man who rushed forward was killed with a knife.
On the verge of death, he finally reacted.
He wanted to yell at the old man who ran away, "You fucking idiot!"
As a result, there was no chance to shout out.
"Escape is also death!"
Ying glanced at the escaping old man, then drew out the long knife in his hand, turned into a black light of death, and pierced him directly from behind.
"Poof!"
She grabbed it with her fingers, and the long black knife that left her hand returned to her hand as if it was being controlled.
